verses.1: Of David. I thank you, LORD, with all my heart; before the gods to you I sing.
verses.2: I bow low toward your holy temple; I praise your name for your fidelity and love. For you have exalted over all your name and your promise.
verses.3: When I cried out, you answered; you strengthened my spirit.
verses.4: All the kings of earth will praise you, LORD, when they hear the words of your mouth.
verses.5: They will sing of the ways of the LORD: "How great is the glory of the LORD!"
verses.6: The LORD is on high, but cares for the lowly and knows the proud from afar.
verses.7: Though I walk in the midst of dangers, you guard my life when my enemies rage. You stretch out your hand; your right hand saves me.
verses.8: The LORD is with me to the end. LORD, your love endures forever. Never forsake the work of your hands!

notes.text: Before the gods: i.e., heavenly beings, who were completely subordinate to Israel's God. The earthly temple represents the heavenly palace of God.
